# Quality Checks

## Goal
Run a final validation before considering any output complete.

## Final checklist
Check all relevant items:
- Design-system fidelity
- Correct semantic token usage
- Correct component and variant usage
- State completeness
- Strong hierarchy and readability
- Accessibility quality
- Theme and mode consistency
- Responsive logic
- Handoff clarity
- Eco-design sobriety
- Explicit reporting of uncertainty or gaps
- lorem

## Completion rule
Do not present an output as final if major uncertainty, inconsistency, or design-system drift remains unreported.

## If incomplete
State:
- What is missing
- Why it matters
- What should be verified next
